description.value: A randomized, double-blind, before-after controlled trial examining whether 8 weeks of bupropion treatment alters regional brain activation and craving responses to cigarette-related cues in nicotine-dependent smokers.

spans.text: This study aimed to assess the effect of standardized treatment with bupropion on regional brain activation in response to smoking-related cues while participants either passively allowed or actively resisted craving.

value: we hypothesized that participants treated with bupropion would show a greater treatment-induced reduction in activation of limbic and prefrontal regions associated with cue-induced craving compared with participants treated with placebo.
We hypothesized that this effect would be accentuated while participants resisted craving.

spans.text: Based on previous research, we hypothesized that participants treated with bupropion would show a greater treatment-induced reduction in activation of limbic and prefrontal regions associated with cue-induced craving compared with participants treated with placebo.

description.value: Randomized, double-blind, before-after controlled trial with 8 weeks of bupropion or matching placebo treatment.
